g.text: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace ◆ Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house ◆ US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs ◆ Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip ◆ Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes ◆ Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data ◆
